source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
If there's a failed check, then download the photos
3. If there is more than one photo (we need to know if there's only one photo because we don't use the default logo)
4. Open the photo.
5. Crop the photo to remove any logos
6. Make a note of any labels in the photos or descriptions in the inspection record
7. Return to the inspection record
8. Compare the photo to the address: If there is no address and the address has been submitted in the inspection record, then overwrite the address in the inspection record with the address that's in the photo
9. Add the address to the documented address field

If there is a photo only then:
10. Add the image to the project driveway folder
10. Add the project name and image name to the image address list
11. Document the image file
